objectClass.notes: A floor-seated Ravenpost service landmark with a house-shaped mail body on one post. Runtime mail state remains external to the GLB.

reasoning: The silhouette is simple at distance but depends on the gabled roof, elevated mail body, single post, triangular braces, and stepped stone foot.
Identity depends on several nested systems: slot and frame, Ravenpost relief, rear shutter, side badges, roof courses, trim, and collar hardware.
Seven admitted views reduce hidden-side risk and support a complete volume rather than a facade card.
A named interaction socket, unread-effect socket, floor socket, and compound collider make the prop action-ready without increasing shipping draw count.

specDepthDecision.rationale: A shallow house-on-post blockout would miss the slot, Ravenpost identity, rear construction, roof rhythm, and grounded service scale.

definitionOfDone: The complete accepted 1.65 by 1.05 by 2.9 yard volume reads as a Ravenpost mailbox from every admitted angle and beside the 2.6-yard player rig.
The gabled cobalt roof, warm timber house, gold-framed open slot, raven relief, single post, braces, collar, and stepped stone footing all survive Low-tier rendering.
The result stays within the 2,000 triangle target and 3,000 triangle hard ceiling with two merged primitives, two materials, zero embedded textures, and zero animations.
Named mail-interaction, unread-effect, and ground sockets plus a compound collider contract remain stable after optimization.
requiredRepeatedSystems: Two roof slopes use four irregular but deterministic cobalt courses each.
Gold fastener heads follow bounded symmetric rows and never become one-off draw calls.
Stone footing blocks form two centered courses with explicit joints and no floating pieces.
requiredMaterialLayers: One merged opaque vertex-color material and one merged metal accent material carry independent semantic zones and the external shared Eastbrook atlas.
Runtime unread glow attaches at Socket_UnreadGlow and is not baked into the mailbox GLB.
blockingFailureModes: A boxy generic birdhouse replaces the reference roof-to-body proportions.
The mail slot is painted rather than a recessed opening with a thick gold frame.
The post, braces, body, or stone courses float or penetrate visibly.
The raven relief, cobalt roof, or gold wayfinding trim disappears on Low.
The asset requires embedded PBR maps or exceeds any hard budget.
A critical feature scores below 0.7 even when the aggregate review score passes.
